audit.why: Lane difficulty text (EVEN, 5.5/10) matches the level chart, which flips to Galio only at Level 6 (ult) and is Skill/even elsewhere — consistent with Galio's kit needing E-W to land before he threatens.

Power spikes are named correctly: Tahm's Q/passive out-trades pre-6, Galio's Hero's Entrance (R) is the global-knockup spike at 6, and first item brings his W/E burst back to even. Real cooldowns confirm the level-6 swing (R is only up every 180/160/140s so the window is rare but decisive).

audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns had no digit and misnamed Tahm's Devour as his W (Devour is R; W is Abyssal Voyage). It also never stated Justice Punch's actual cooldown or the Colossal Smash auto-reset tell from missingInteractions.
audit.why: Devour is Tahm's R per ownerKit (text: 'devours a champion... shielding if ally'), not his W (W is the dive-and-knockup Abyssal Voyage). Justice Punch (Galio E) cooldown is 11/10/9/8/7s by rank per enemyKit, and Galio's P (Colossal Smash) telegraphs his combo opener with an auto-reset wind-up before the reset auto lands.
audit.corrected: Fixed R/W mislabel, added real Justice Punch cooldown, and folded in the auto-reset tell.

edits.before: - Galio Justice Punch: matchup-defining — His dash knockup — he has no engage while it is down. Read it before every duo step-up. - Your W Devour (ally save) answers exactly one disaster per cooldown. - Spend the R on swing moments only.
edits.after: - Galio's Justice Punch (E) is down 11/10/9/8/7s by rank — no dash engage while it's on cooldown, and his P auto-reset wind-up tells you the combo is starting before the reset auto lands. - Your R Devour (ally save) answers exactly one disaster per cast. - Spend it on swing moments only.

edits.before: Bait the answer, start the chain, and let your carry collect — engage trades are all-or-nothing; pick the all.
edits.after: Tongue Lash (Q) slows on hit and stacks An Acquired Taste — land it as their duo regroups so your third stack stuns before Galio's E-W combo does.

edits.before: Engaging into a banked disengage — the chain that starts answered is a donation with intentions.
edits.after: Don't burn Flash on Justice Punch's damage — Galio has no dash of his own if it whiffs, but the E can wall off your retreat, so hold Flash for the terrain, not the hit.
